coverage.detail: Player owns Ghosty position, spawns at starting x, rightward velocity is constant
Physics applies constant downward gravity acceleration
Physics applies upward impulse to Player on spacebar (Input → Player → Physics)
Physics enforces world boundaries (ceiling and ground constraints)
Physics detects ceiling collision, reports to GameLoop; GameLoop transitions to ended state
Physics detects ground collision, reports to GameLoop; GameLoop transitions to ended state
Obstacles spawns walls at regular horizontal intervals during gameplay
Obstacles creates two vertical wall segments with gap between them
Obstacles randomizes gap position vertically within safe bounds (not at edges)
Obstacles maintains consistent gap size throughout playthrough
Physics detects collision between Player and wall segments; GameLoop ends game
Physics detects wall collision, reports to GameLoop; GameLoop transitions to ended state
Scoring increments on pass-through event detected by GameLoop (Player passes gap)
Rendering queries Scoring and draws current score on HUD during gameplay
Rendering displays final score on end screen
Scoring tracks high score across sessions via Persistence
GameLoop starts in ready state (not playing)
GameLoop transitions ready→playing on Input flap event
GameLoop runs update loop until collision detected by Physics
Rendering draws end screen with final score, high score, and menu options
Rendering displays menu options (Play Again, Settings, Quit) on end screen
Audio plays sound effects on events: Input.onFlap(), Scoring.onPointEarned(), Physics collision
Audio plays background music during GameLoop playing state
Audio respects mute state toggled from settings menu
GameLoop runs identically regardless of audio state; Audio is optional
Persistence saves high score to browser localStorage
Persistence persists high score across page refreshes and browser sessions
Scoring loads high score from Persistence on initialization
